metadata.mechanics: The performer of this procedure must spend 1 Minute of Full Engagement Roleplay tampering with an item, crime scene, or freshly-killed corpse that has not yet decayed into the Mortis. They may then spend up to 4 Resolve, 1 for each of the questions that can be gained through investigative uses of Master Lockpicking & Security, informing a Guide with fictitious answers that will be provided to any such investigator.
metadata.notes: A Guide must be present for the use of this procedure, and should remain afterwards for a time in case of investigations (to provide the answers).
metadata.requirementsToUse: Master Lockpicking & Security, Lore: Shady Operations, and Society Membership: Mental & Social Control
metadata.validTargetDescription: One item or corpse / one crime scene
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: A quick stitch of a blade wound, an application of chemicals around the mouth to leave evidence of poisoning, the filing away of marks on a lock to make it look as if it had never been picked - the master thieves and manipulators of the Black Market can make it seem that they were never present.
